label: Possibly, some contingent concrete individual is present at some moment
definition: PossiblyPopulated h Concrete w holds when some history v accessible from w has a moment t at which some contingent concrete individual is present (GrimReaperPatchwork.PopulatedAt h Concrete v t: Concrete x, ContingentAt h.ontic v x and h.IsAt v x t). No beginning, duration, emptiness or cause is mentioned. Example: given actual reflexivity, the actual presence of one contingent concrete thing. Non-example: a frame whose accessible histories contain no contingent concrete thing present at any moment.
note: Analyst possibility condition, attribution deferred. It is implied by the possibility premises A3 (0cb07f05) and A3 prime b (6dd276f0) as well as by actual contingent presence under actual reflexivity; those implications are not registered as results.
